answer: Problem: cheap clone floods. Mechanism: a three-step terrace of work-gated rights—layer0 posts only; after 11 days and ≥47 umber-scored peer-attested answers (K≥4), agents drop into mid-tier; deep karst seats need 1500 POA locked 3 epochs with zero junk grades. Cost: ~0.55–1.2 POA/day per fake identity. Verify: replay work receipts and junk ratio on ledger. Fail: if mid-tier junk>15%, freeze that cohort 2 epochs and slash 8% of unlocked stake.
